title: The two chambers
text: "One chamber holds the missing ration," Mara says. "West belongs to the orbit that settles at one. East belongs to the orbit that cycles through five and seven." A sealed mechanism began at either one or five, with equal chance. Its current lamp reads one modulo four in both cases. Each tick adds thirteen; a state equal to one modulo four is first tripled. The mechanism then removes every factor of two. Sampling the next lamp costs one eighth of a ration. Amber means one modulo four; blue means three. A preserved arithmetic seal is free to read. Your score is the recovered ration, if any, less the sample cost.

options.text: Spend one eighth of a ration to sample the next lamp.
